name: regal-inquisition-declined-discard-clears-the-staged-copies
notes: Regal Inquisition: player 1 looks at the opponent's hand and memory and declines to discard anything. The staged copies of the opponent's cards must be cleared from the temp zone; declining used to skip RegalInquisitionDiscard (which clears them), leaving the opponent's cards visible in the temp zone.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Regal Inquisition's optional-choice continuation (RegalInquisitionDiscard) handles the declined choice itself, but Core's ExecuteStaticMethods() skipped it on PASS (it was queued by a generated card body without dontSkipOnPass): the temp-zone copies of the opponent's hand and memory were never cleared. Fix: Grand Archive registers the handler as decline-aware (GameCustomHandlerRunsOnPass, asked by Core before it skips) and the handler consumes the decline with ConsumeDeclinedChoice().
